How do I connect to my LEVI server?
Open Server settings and enter your LEVI server URL. If the server is on this same device or your local network with a loopback address, http:// is accepted; everywhere else LEVI requires https://.
Why does http:// only work for 127.0.0.1?

Plain HTTP sends your data unencrypted. LEVI only trusts it on loopback addresses (127.0.0.1, ::1) where traffic never leaves the device. Any other host must use HTTPS, enforced by the app\'s network security config.
App lock asks for your PIN (or device biometrics) before LEVI opens. It protects the app on this device — it does not encrypt your files, and it cannot recover a forgotten PIN.
